people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Therefore glorify Yahweh in the east, even the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!
translations.bsb: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east. Extol the name of the LORD, the God of Israel in the islands of the sea.
translations.kjv: Wherefore glorify ye the LORD in the fires, even the name of the LORD God of Israel in the isles of the sea.
translations.asv: Wherefore glorify ye Jehovah in the east, even the name of Jehovah, the God of Israel, in the isles of the sea.
